decisions.reason: As a 2018 launch with its own webpage, it reflects visible recent investment and the firm is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course quickly.
Although website commitment is more limited, it is still a very recent launch in the firm’s core drainage range, so management would usually give it more time.
